name: world
description: Build a setting: its history, rules and peoples, checked for consistency and broken into worldbuilding deliverables

steps.name: World Sketch
steps.prompt_prefix: Sketch this world: its geography, its history in a few defining events, its peoples and powers, the rules that make it different (magic, technology, gods, economics), and the tensions that could drive stories.

steps.name: Canon Check
steps.prompt_prefix: Check this world for consistency. List every rule and fact it establishes, then every contradiction, gap or rule that is too convenient. Propose fixes that keep what is interesting.

steps.name: Player and Reader View
steps.prompt_prefix: Look at this world from outside: what would a newcomer find confusing, generic or hard to care about? What is the one thing they would remember? What should they learn first?

steps.name: World Bible
steps.prompt_prefix: Consolidate everything above into one world bible: the canon facts and rules, a short timeline, the peoples and factions, the places that matter, and the open questions. Mark which facts are fixed and which are still open.

steps.name: Deliverables
steps.prompt_prefix: Break this world bible into worldbuilding deliverables: timeline, faction sheets, location notes, a glossary, a newcomer primer, and the open questions to decide. Use ### DELIVERABLE N: Title headers.
